# REQ: LANG-321 LANG-322 LANG-323 LANG-324 LANG-325
defmodule Demo.Greeter do
  @moduledoc """
  Greets people. Version #{@version}
  """
  @version "1.0"

  defstruct name: "world", times: 1

  def greet(%__MODULE__{name: name, times: times}) when times > 0 do
    text = "Hello, #{name}!\n"
    words = ~w(alpha beta gamma)
    pattern = ~r/\d+ "quoted"/i
    opts = [key: :value, other: nil]
    case Enum.count(words) do
      3 -> String.duplicate(text, times)
      _ -> {:error, :unexpected}
    end
  end

  defp private?(x), do: x == 'chars' or x != 0x1F + 1_000 + 3.14
end

Demo.Greeter.greet(%Demo.Greeter{}) |> IO.puts()
